explicitExclusions.reason: Existing application changes belong to the independently completed module audit.
Derived audit inputs/results; consumed as data and validated by reviewed merger.

openQuestions.question: The first standalone full CLI audit should use a fresh run ID; current production audit ran through native isolated agents.

surfaces.label: scripts/security-check.ps1
surfaces.notes: scripts/security-check.ps1:1 - Fresh ephemeral read-only sessions; fixed CLI flags; no shell-string evaluation of model JSON. RunId/module IDs are bounded. Process failure stops; merger propagates nonzero status.

surfaces.label: scripts/security-check.py
surfaces.notes: scripts/security-check.py:1 - Strict module/result/decision schema, source hashes, exact line bounds, complete coverage, duplicate target closure, constrained supporting sources and output containment/link checks. Markdown values are escaped. An output hash is drift evidence, not a signature of model truth.

surfaces.label: scripts/test_security_check.py
surfaces.notes: scripts/test_security_check.py:1 - Fifteen synthetic regression cases cover traversal, stale source, missing coverage/decisions, duplicate cycles, severity preservation, support-source drift and report escaping.

surfaces.label: security-check/modules.json
surfaces.notes: security-check/modules.json:1 - Exactly one owner per active source file; explicit generated/binary exclusions. No real credentials or additional dependency introduced.

surfaces.label: docs/security-check-workflow.md
surfaces.notes: docs/security-check-workflow.md:1 - Documents execution scope, process-only ExecutionPolicy flag, context-isolation limits, result codes and pre-v1 Deep Scan requirement.

surfaces.label: .gitignore
surfaces.notes: .gitignore:1 - Only this task addition ignores Python bytecode under scripts; existing user modifications preserved.
